claims: The first Artemis launch is Artemis I.
Artemis I launched at 1:47 a.m. EST.
Artemis I launched from Kennedy Space Center, Florida.
Artemis I launch site was LC-39B, Kennedy Space Center.
Artemis I was an uncrewed lunar flight test.
Artemis I launch vehicle was Space Launch System (SLS) Block 1.
Artemis I used the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket.
Artemis I sent the Orion spacecraft around the Moon.
Artemis I splashed down on December 11, 2022.
Artemis I mission duration was 25 days, 10 hours, 53 minutes.
The goal of Artemis I was to test the integrated systems (rocket and capsule) before carrying human crews
